name: Taurifer UI screen catalog
description: Every user-visible mobile surface, captured from the production UI. Onboarding is covered state by state so no route is represented only by its first screen.

screens.label: First-run gate
screens.scenario: No program exists. The gate that precedes every entry route.

screens.label: Entry hub
screens.scenario: Create a program. Recommend and Custom carry the accent rail; Browse and Bring or build my own recede.

screens.label: Entry hub — own disclosure open
screens.scenario: The Bring or build my own disclosure expanded to reveal the nested Build and Import rows.

screens.label: Entry hub — existing program
screens.scenario: Opened from Settings while a program is active, so replacement consequences are in view.

screens.label: Recommend 1 — desired result
screens.scenario: Route header, Cancel, progress 1 of 5, three desired-result choices.

screens.label: Recommend 2 — training background
screens.scenario: Structured-program experience and recent six-week consistency.

screens.label: Recommend 3 — real week
screens.scenario: Days per week, session-minute ceiling, preferred rest.

screens.label: Recommend 4 — environment
screens.scenario: Environment shortcuts with the capability correction disclosure closed.

screens.label: Recommend 4 — equipment correction
screens.scenario: The capability correction disclosure open.

screens.label: Recommend 5 — priorities
screens.scenario: Primary priorities plus optional movement and exercise-avoidance controls.

screens.label: Recommend 5 — avoidance and pain safety
screens.scenario: One avoided exercise with the pain reason selected and its safety copy.

screens.label: Recommend — validation error
screens.scenario: Advancing without an answer. Errors sit adjacent to the control that failed.

screens.label: Recommend — recommendation
screens.scenario: One named recommendation with its factual Why it fits explanation.

screens.label: Recommend — review before first activation
screens.scenario: Identity, source, day summaries, assumptions, Edit before using, Use this program.

screens.label: Recommend — review with a program active
screens.scenario: The same review while the current program remains untouched.

screens.label: Recommend — confirm replacement
screens.scenario: The explicit archive-and-replace confirmation. History is not changed.

screens.label: Recommend — activation conflict
screens.scenario: Another tab changed the active program. The newer program stays active.

screens.label: Custom 1 — desired result
screens.scenario: The custom route's own header and step count, not Recommend's.

screens.label: Custom 2 — training background
screens.scenario: Structured-program experience and recent consistency in the custom route.

screens.label: Custom 3 — real week
screens.scenario: Days per week, session ceiling and preferred rest in the custom route.

screens.label: Custom 4 — environment
screens.scenario: Environment shortcuts in the custom route.

screens.label: Custom 5 — muscle priorities
screens.scenario: Each muscle has one accessible emphasis setting before exercise preferences.

screens.label: Custom 6 — exercise preferences
screens.scenario: One library search offers Include or Avoid, with separate selected lists.

screens.label: Custom — generated program
screens.scenario: The generated candidate for the chosen split.

screens.label: Custom — review
screens.scenario: The common review surface for a custom-generated program.

screens.label: Browse 1 — real week
screens.scenario: Days per week and session length, the only questions Browse asks.

screens.label: Browse 2 — environment
screens.scenario: Environment shortcuts before the catalogue is filtered.

screens.label: Browse — catalogue
screens.scenario: Released, complete, tested programs with purpose, frequency and mismatches.

screens.label: Browse — review
screens.scenario: The common review surface for a catalogue program.

screens.label: Build 1 — name and days
screens.scenario: The build_setup step: program name and day count before the editor opens.

screens.label: Build — empty days
screens.scenario: Real empty day containers, Add exercise, Save draft, activation disabled.

screens.label: Build — partial draft
screens.scenario: One populated day and one incomplete day. Activation stays disabled.

screens.label: Build — activation ready
screens.scenario: A complete manual draft with supported progression and activation enabled.

screens.label: Import — source
screens.scenario: The bounded supported-file and setup-source surface before any mutation.

screens.label: Import — review
screens.scenario: A mapped exercise with manual progression ownership and provenance.

screens.label: Shared setup — confirmation gate
screens.scenario: The first-run gate for an incoming setup link. Nothing persists until Start.

screens.label: Shared setup — review
screens.scenario: The editable preview a shared payload lands in before explicit activation.

screens.label: Resume setup
screens.scenario: The resumable notice after reload: route, step, recency, Resume, Start over.

screens.label: Rules changed
screens.scenario: A draft whose compiler rules are stale. Rebuild is required before activation.

screens.label: Today — ready to start
